description: This file is a PHP plugin for the Smarty templating engine, defining a compiler modifier function 'wordwrap' that wraps text at a specified length with optional parameters for line break string and soft or hard line breaking.

methods.description: Compiles the 'wordwrap' modifier to be used within Smarty templates, returning the appropriate wrapped string using possibly mbstring-aware wrapping function.
